title: Fly to Hong Kong, harbour night
cond: Tokyo heavy rain early, Hong Kong cloudy
call: Tokyo is the watch. tenki.jp's forecaster has the low moving away on Tuesday, but with steady, locally heavy rain from dawn into the morning along the southern Kanto coast, which is where Haneda is, easing by midday. Now a taxi from the hotel at 06:40, so the rain matters less: allow a little extra time on the expressway, and check CX543 in the Cathay app on Monday night and Tuesday morning. Hong Kong: mainly cloudy, sunny periods later, 26 to 30°, breezy north-easterly, fine for the evening harbour cruise.
plan: Aqua Luna harbour cruise, Hong Kong
